text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Grass Wonder prepared matcha for 
me in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how does today's outfit look on 
me~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm glad. I can't offer 
hospitality on the level of a proper tea 
ceremony, but I put my whole heart into 
it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's tea gathering— I'm sure it 
will be a lovely and delightful occasion.
choice_data_list:
I'd love to try it during a tea ceremony 
someday...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! You're interested? In that 
case, shall I set aside some time for us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conversation turned into wanting to 
try it out, and we ended up arranging to 
do so on the next day off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, on our day off, I arrived at the 
place Grass Wonder had specified.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Trainer. I'll prepare a seat for 
you, right this way.
choice_data_list: It's more authentic than I imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with the utmost hospitality. And 
also—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you already know, but please be 
careful not to step on the threshold.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am serving as the kettle attendant 
today, so please come take a seat before 
the tea kettle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is usually so graceful and 
refined, but today she carries a 
completely different aura.
choice_data_list:
(She's serious... I have to give it my all 
in return!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared some tea sweets. Here, 
please help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is it proper for me to accept this...? 
Surely there must be a clear protocol. If 
one considers etiquette... if one 
considers it—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Accepting it without fuss would have 
been the right move. The etiquette lessons 
only grew stricter after that—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please use the provided chopsticks to take 
the sweets.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Next, wipe the chopsticks with the 
kaishi paper and place them back on the 
sweet dish.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then. Allow me to write a few words.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I can record the parts where you 
stumbled, Trainer, we can focus on 
drilling them repeatedly...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, please enjoy it just as it is.
choice_data_list:
(I can finally drink it... That felt like 
forever...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list: Ah, umm... the next move is...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... Please, feel free to sit 
comfortably and relax your legs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... It seems I got a little too 
carried away while teaching etiquette.
choice_data_list:
They really put their all into 
entertaining us, didn't they?

They really put their all into 
entertaining us, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That is true, but... I just got so happy, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as long as you learn the proper 
etiquette, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I thought perhaps we might be able to 
enjoy tea parties together for a long time 
to come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her strict guidance was born from 
her excitement for our future together. In 
that case...
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best so we can enjoy it even 
more together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad. Hearing you say that 
makes me very happy...
choice_data_list: Yeah. When should we do the next one?
Yeah. When should we do it next?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Hehe. And here I was planning 
to invite you myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I, too, look forward to the day when the 
two of us can share teatime again.
choice_data_list: I don't mind if it's tough next time too!
Please go easy on me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I've reflected on it myself. Next 
time, I'll make sure to be gentler.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I'm eagerly looking forward to 
being invited once you've learned the ways 
of tea, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I was too strict with you. 
Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, calling me teacher...? Hehe. You're 
quite a big student, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, for my final lesson of the day. Let 
us embrace harmony and appreciate the 
refined atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us take our time and enjoy this 
moment. Without words... in quiet peace.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Reflecting on the day, while dreaming of 
fun plans to come."
